mapper.select: select reservation.quarantine_reservation_id, reservation.request_id, reservation.adjudication_action_id, reservation.child_transfer_id, reservation.child_transfer_detail_id, reservation.reservation_round, reservation.receipt_allocation_id, reservation.shipment_allocation_id, reservation.stock_id, reservation.quarantine_balance_id, reservation.quarantine_lot_id, reservation.quarantine_location_id, reservation.item_type, reservation.item_id, reservation.product_id, reservation.tracking_policy, reservation.reserved_quantity, reservation.consumed_quantity, reservation.released_quantity, reservation.source_cost_price, reservation.reserved_amount, reservation.decision_fingerprint, reservation.status as reservation_status, reservation.version as reservation_version, child.status as child_status, child.approval_round, coalesce(nullif(child.from_warehouse_id, 0), child.from_dept_id) as source_warehouse_id, child.source_business_type, child.source_business_id, detail.quantity as requested_quantity, detail.delivered_quantity, workflow.workflow_id, workflow.workflow_type, workflow.inventory_source, workflow.workflow_fingerprint from inv_transfer_quarantine_reservation reservation inner join inv_transfer_order child on child.transfer_id = reservation.child_transfer_id and child.transfer_id = #{childTransferId} and child.approval_round = reservation.reservation_round inner join inv_transfer_detail detail on detail.detail_id = reservation.child_transfer_detail_id and detail.transfer_id = child.transfer_id inner join inv_transfer_receipt_discrepancy_adjudication_workflow_link workflow on workflow.adjudication_action_id = reservation.adjudication_action_id and workflow.child_transfer_id = child.transfer_id and workflow.source_business_type = child.source_business_type and workflow.source_business_id = child.source_business_id where reservation.child_transfer_id = #{childTransferId} and child.source_business_type = 'transfer_discrepancy_return' and child.source_business_id = reservation.adjudication_action_id and workflow.workflow_type = 'return' and workflow.inventory_source = 'quarantine_detail' and workflow.quarantine_balance_id = reservation.quarantine_balance_id and workflow.quarantine_lot_id = reservation.quarantine_lot_id and workflow.quarantine_location_id = reservation.quarantine_location_id and (select count(1) from inv_transfer_detail all_detail where all_detail.transfer_id = child.transfer_id) = 1

select binding.quarantine_reservation_serial_id, binding.quarantine_reservation_id, binding.receipt_serial_id, binding.serial_id, binding.serial_no_snapshot, binding.warehouse_id, binding.balance_id, binding.lot_id, binding.location_id, binding.lifecycle_status, binding.version as binding_version, serial.serial_no as current_serial_no, serial.serial_status as current_serial_status, serial.warehouse_id as current_warehouse_id, serial.balance_id as current_balance_id, serial.lot_id as current_lot_id, serial.location_id as current_location_id from inv_transfer_quarantine_reservation_serial binding inner join inv_inventory_serial serial on serial.serial_id = binding.serial_id and serial.serial_no = binding.serial_no_snapshot where binding.quarantine_reservation_id = #{fact.reservationId} and binding.lifecycle_status = 'ACTIVE' order by binding.receipt_serial_id, binding.serial_id
